name: Hinata Mizuki
source:
Mizuki loves to swim; in fact, the reason why she enrolled at Eiden is so that she could swim in the ocean whenever she wanted. With the soft currents and warm waters, she used to swim naked from time to time, but hasn't ever since the boys saw her. 

She is very athletic and a little boyish, making her so popular amongst the girls that she has a bodyguard squad, but she has no interest in them. Due to her lack of experience around boys, she sometimes comes off as a little hostile towards them, but she actually yearns to be in love. Also, she loves fancy accessories, just like any other girl.
